description: This file defines an abstract base class for an authentication service supporting SASL mechanisms (PLAIN and EXTERNAL), including methods for authentication and verification that subclasses must implement.

classes.name: AbstractHonoAuthenticationService
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for authentication services supporting SASL PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles authentication requests based on the specified SASL mechanism and delegates actual verification to subclasses.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement verification of SASL PLAIN credentials.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement verification of SASL EXTERNAL Subject DNs.
